cohort: Obese women (BMI ≥ 30 kg/m2) with cephalic singleton births at or beyond 39 weeks of gestation between 2013 and 2017 in the US
finding: Induction of labor at 39 weeks among obese women appears to lower the risk of CD, without compromising maternal outcomes.
mod_finding: This study found that inducing labor at 39 weeks in obese women was associated with a lower risk of cesarean delivery compared to not inducing labor at 39 weeks.
